statement: Compute annual illuminance and daylight metrics (daylight autonomy, useful daylight illuminance, spatial daylight autonomy) for a Rhino model with a weather file and occupancy schedule.

acceptance.corpus: LM-83 ASE test room
acceptance.tolerance: ASE area percent within 2 points of reference

statement: Compute point-in-time illuminance on a sensor grid for a chosen date, time and sky condition.

acceptance.tolerance: DGP exceedance hours within 5% of reference
